info.title: LHA mission API
info.description:
The API every LHA implementation's `lha serve` provides, and the only thing the mission UI and MCP clients depend on (docs/27-mission-ui.md). Any implementation's server reads any implementation's missions: it reads the mission store, the `.lha/` anchor, `mission_events` and the Temporal wire contract only.

The server binds to 127.0.0.1 and refuses a request whose `Host` is not its own loopback address. Every request needs the token printed at start-up: as the `X-LHA-Token` header, or (reads only) the `lha_token` cookie the UI's start-up URL sets. No CORS.

Compatibility: within `/api/v1`, changes are additive only (new paths, new optional fields, new event kinds). A client ignores fields and event kinds it does not know.

get.description: A Server-Sent Events stream. Each `mission_event` message carries one `MissionEvent` as `data`, with its id as the SSE `id`, so a reconnecting `EventSource` resumes after the last one it saw (`Last-Event-ID`). A `mission` message carries a `MissionSummary` when a mission's row changes (it has no id). A comment line is sent every 15 seconds so idle connections stay open. Every client is served by one shared reader; the stream never polls per client.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Start after this event id (default: only new events). `Last-Event-ID` wins when both are sent.

200.description: The stream (never ends on its own).

schema.description: `text/event-stream`: `event: mission_event` messages (data: a `MissionEvent`) and `event: mission` messages (data: a `MissionSummary`).

401.description: No valid token (`X-LHA-Token` header, or the `lha_token` cookie for reads).

post.summary: Answer the open human gate, recording who answered (`human_decision_v2`)
post.description: Sends the `human_decision_v2` signal, as `lha mission-approve --as` does. The decision must be one of the open gate's options (422 otherwise); with no gate open, any decision is held for the next gate. `by` is recorded on the gate row. Not available over MCP: an agent must not answer its own gates.

token_header.name: X-LHA-Token
token_header.description: The token `lha serve` prints at start-up. Required for every write.

token_cookie.name: lha_token
token_cookie.description: Set (`SameSite=Strict`, `HttpOnly`) when the UI's start-up URL is opened. Accepted for reads only.

implementation.description: `python`, `go` or `rust`: which implementation serves. Informational only.

degraded_reason.description: Non-empty when a configured Postgres is unusable and SQLite is read instead.

CostSummary.description: Spend recorded in the cost ledger. `known_usd` sums the calls with a known cost; a call whose cost is unknown is counted, never valued at $0.

status.description: The store's status: `RUNNING`, `SLEEPING`, `WAITING_ON_HUMAN`, `DEGRADED_PARK`, `DONE`, `ABORTED`, `IMPOSSIBLE`, or a local run's status. A client shows an unknown status as it is.

durable.description: Run by a Temporal workflow (controls are available).

items.description: `null` when the anchor cannot be read here.

status.description: The store's status: `RUNNING`, `SLEEPING`, `WAITING_ON_HUMAN`, `DEGRADED_PARK`, `DONE`, `ABORTED`, `IMPOSSIBLE`, or a local run's status. A client shows an unknown status as it is.

durable.description: Run by a Temporal workflow (controls are available).

items.description: `null` when the anchor cannot be read here.

workdir.description: Where the mission's anchor is, as recorded by its run.

live.description: The workflow's own state; `null` for a local run, a finished mission, or when Temporal is unreachable (see `live_error`).

MissionDetail.description: A `MissionSummary` plus the mission's description, workdir and live workflow state.

resume_at.description: When a sleeping mission wakes (ISO-8601 UTC).

LiveState.description: The answers to the workflow's queries (the wire contract), fetched at most every few seconds per mission and shared.

request.description: The irreversible action awaiting approval (a `tool_call` gate).

ChecklistEdit.description: One edit of a `checklist_edit_v1` batch (`spec/state/checklist_edit.json`): `add` takes a description; every other op takes the `id` of the item it changes.

kind.description: The event kind. A client ignores kinds it does not know.

MissionEvent.description: One row of `mission_events`. For every kind in `spec/obs/mission_events.json`, `payload` matches that kind's schema.

usd.description: `null` when the call's cost is unknown (never $0).

status.description: `OPEN`, `ESCALATED` (a reminder was sent), `RESOLVED` or `DEFAULTED` (its deadline passed).

resolved_at.description: When it was resolved or defaulted (`""` while open).
